items.title: 3 Defensive Dividend Stocks Retail Investors Are Watching For Reliable Income
items.summary: With the Fed leaning hard on inflation data and keeping the door open to more rate hikes, many investors are wondering whether to stay in the market or sit on their hands. Higher-for-longer rates can punish some stocks yet create rare windows in others that still aim to pay reliable dividends. This article examines three large-cap defensive dividend stocks exposed to this backdrop and explains why each could matter for your portfolio decisions right now.
